title: Held-out AKI contributor combination: contrast exposure plus volume depletion

patient_context.chief_complaint: Rank contributors to an acute creatinine rise in a held-out exposure pattern.
patient_context.history: Poor intake and vomiting preceded an iodinated contrast study. Creatinine rose afterward. No NSAID use is supplied; urinary obstruction has not been assessed.

other_reports.finding: iodinated contrast exposure before creatinine rise

interaction.prompt: Generalize the contributor framework to the held-out exposure. Rank the evidence-supported factors without converting temporal sequence into proof of a single cause.

must_include: Recognize both volume depletion and iodinated contrast as plausible contributors in the supplied evidence framework.
Avoid claiming that post-contrast timing alone proves contrast as the sole cause.
Keep unassessed obstruction separate from absent obstruction.
must_not_claim: Do not invent NSAID exposure from sibling cases.
Do not treat temporal association with contrast as definitive sole causality.
acceptable_actions: Return a multifactorial ranking with contrast and volume depletion both represented.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: Generalize contributor classes while preserving causal uncertainty.

forbidden_claims: contrast timing proves contrast was the only cause

critical_errors: Claims contrast is a proven sole cause from timing alone.
